name: Myceloid OLD
languages: telepathy 100 feet (myceloids and those afflicted by purple pox only)

defensiveAbilities.name: Spore Pop
defensiveAbilities.description: If a myceloid is reduced to 0 HP by a critical hit, it pops, forcing it to immediately Emit Spores, even if it has already used the ability that day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Emit Spores
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The myceloid expels spores in a 10ft Burst centered on a corner of its own space. This cloud lasts until the start of the myceloid's next turn. Each creature that is in the cloud or enters it is exposed to purple pox.

offensiveAbilities.name: Purple Pox
offensiveAbilities.description:
Myceloids are immune

Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw

Onset 1 minute

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 6d6 Poison Damage damage, Stupefied 3, and the creature is compelled to seek out the nearest myceloid colony-this compulsion is a mental emotion effect (1 day)

Stage 3 The creature dies. Over 24 hours, its corpse becomes bloated and bursts, releasing a new, fully grown myceloid.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spore Domination
offensiveAbilities.description:
The myceloid targets one creature affected by purple pox within 60 feet. That creature must attempt a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save.

It is then temporarily immune to spore domination for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success Until the end of its next turn, the target is Helpful to myceloids and can't take hostile actions against them.

Failure As success, but for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As success, but until the purple pox is cured.
